market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are the 2024 IPL champions with 3 titles historically (~18% win rate). In a 10-team league, even the weakest team would have >5% chance, and KKR is mid-tier or better. The market-implied probability of 2.1% vastly understates their true chances, which I estimate around 8%.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL title just last season.
Historical IPL win rate for KKR is 3/17 ≈ 17.6%.
Even the weakest IPL team typically has ≥5% implied probability from betting markets.
No team in the IPL is as bad as a 2% longshot given playoff variance.
